description: This file defines a wrapper interface and implementation class for GLib functions, facilitating interactions with GMainLoop and signal handling in a C++ context. It declares classes, virtual methods, static methods, and extern C function declarations related to GLib signal handling.

classes.name: GLibWrapsImpl
classes.description: Abstract class defining interface for GLib wrapper implementations, including virtual methods for checking main loop status and managing signal handlers.

classes.name: GLibWraps
classes.description: Singleton-like class providing static interface to GLib functions, with the ability to set custom implementations.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Sets the static implementation of the GLibWrapsImpl interface.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton instance of GLibWraps.

methods.name: g_main_loop_is_running
methods.description: Checks if a GMainLoop is currently running.

methods.name: g_signal_connect_data
methods.description: Connects a callback to a signal with additional data and flags.

methods.name: signal_handlers_disconnect_by_data
methods.description: Disconnects signal handlers associated with specific data.

methods.name: signal_handlers_disconnect_by_func
methods.description: Disconnects signal handlers associated with a specific callback function.
